WITH c_cols AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.element = 's'
),
c_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM c_cols
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c_cols.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
),
c_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM c_bonds
    INNER JOIN bond AS b ON c_bonds.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
),
t_final AS (
    SELECT m.label
    FROM c_double_bonds
    INNER JOIN molecule AS m ON c_double_bonds.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT * FROM t_final;
